name: nRF52 Firmware Updates
description: The nRF52 platform supports firmware updates over the air (OTA). The **only supported bootloader** for OTA updates is **MCUboot**. MCUboot can be used as a second-stage bootloader, enabling OTA updates even when the board was originally shipped with a different bootloader.

config_entries.label: Status
config_entries.description: Configure a GPIO pin that MCUboot will use as an indication LED during OTA updates.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Transport
config_entries.description: Specifies the transport method used by Zephyr MCUmgr for OTA updates. By default, Bluetooth Low Energy (`ble: true`) is enabled.

config_entries.label: BLE
config_entries.description: Enable Bluetooth Low Energy transport for MCUmgr OTA. Default false.

config_entries.label: Hardware UART
config_entries.description: Select a hardware UART interface to use for MCUmgr OTA communication. This is used when updating devices over a serial interface rather than BLE. Options: CDC, CDC1, UART0, UART1.
